headline: AB Enzymes launches bread freshness enzyme; Barry Callebaut sales fall 15%; ADM egg fermentation
summary: AB Enzymes has launched a new freshness enzyme for baked goods, a direct challenge to Puratos's anti-staling improvers that Bakery should benchmark quickly.
Barry Callebaut reported full-year sales down 15% amid cocoa pressures, which may open customer and pricing opportunities for Belcolade.
ADM is expanding precision fermentation into egg and whey proteins, a possible future source of animal-free egg for cakes and fillings.
In North America, Univar now distributes Roquette plant proteins and izzio artisan bakery is growing 40% under new commercial leadership, both worth a sales follow-up.
On policy, calls for an FDA definition of ultra-processed foods and momentum for salt substitutes point to more clean-label and sodium-reduction requests from customers.

items.title: AB Enzymes launches freshness solution for baking
items.summary: AB Enzymes has launched a new enzyme-based freshness solution for baked goods.
items.why: A direct competitor move in anti-staling enzymes against Puratos's improvers and freshness range; get the spec and benchmark it (Bakery).

items.title: Barry Callebaut full-year results show sales down 15% amid key tests
items.summary: Barry Callebaut's full-year results show sales down 15% as cocoa prices and volumes test the business.
items.why: The largest chocolate competitor is under pressure, which could open customer and pricing opportunities for Belcolade (Chocolate).

items.title: Polyphenol-Based Preservation for Extended Shelf Life of Pullman Bread
items.summary: Greek researchers show that a commercial polyphenol-based preservative (Flavomix ACE) can stop mould on pullman bread for 55 days at high doses, compared with sorbate and propionate.
items.why: A clean-label alternative to propionate for packaged bread; worth benchmarking against Puratos's own mould-inhibition solutions (Bakery).

items.title: Chocolate Industry Turns To Financial Markets To Pay For Cocoa – Analysis
items.summary: An analysis piece describes how chocolate makers are turning to financial markets and new financing structures to pay for expensive cocoa.
items.why: Cocoa financing and hedging practices affect Belcolade's cost base and customer pricing (Chocolate).

items.title: ADM targets egg, whey and pet food proteins in precision fermentation growth plan
items.summary: ADM plans to grow precision fermentation, targeting egg and whey proteins plus pet food proteins.
items.why: Precision-fermented egg proteins from a major supplier could enable egg replacement in cakes and fillings; a potential sourcing partner (Patisserie).

items.title: Naturally Fermented Pita Breads: Toufayan Bakeries Debuts Simply Sourdough Pita
items.summary: Toufayan Bakeries has launched Simply Sourdough Pita, a naturally fermented pita bread in US retail.
items.why: Sourdough is spreading to flatbreads in US retail, an opening for Sapore sourdough applications with flatbread makers (Bakery).

items.title: Salt Substitutes Could Soon Replace Sodium in Foods and Help Lower Blood Pressure
items.summary: Salt substitutes may soon be used more widely to replace sodium in foods, with policy attention on blood pressure.
items.why: Supports demand for sodium reduction in bread, where Puratos can offer salt-reduction solutions to customers (Bakery).

items.title: Descriptive Consensus Pathway Analysis Identifies Matrix-Dependent Metabolic Patterns During Wheat-Germ Fermentation
items.summary: An NMR metabolomics study maps how wheat germ, with or without semolina, changes during sourdough fermentation with a defined starter.
items.why: Fermented wheat germ is an upcycled sourdough ingredient idea for Sapore-type flavour and nutrition (Bakery).

items.title: Tesco’s Vegan Chocolate Orange Segments Are Here For The Holidays
items.summary: Tesco has launched vegan chocolate orange segments for the holiday season.
items.why: Retailer own-label vegan chocolate shows plant-based seasonal demand, relevant to plant-based Belcolade lines (Chocolate).

items.title: izzio artisan bakery Names Sara Kafadar President and Chief Commercial Officer Amid 40% Retail Sales Growth
items.summary: izzio artisan bakery has named Sara Kafadar President and Chief Commercial Officer, citing 40% retail sales growth.
items.why: A fast-growing US artisan bread brand with new commercial leadership is a sales target for sourdough and clean-label solutions (Bakery).

items.title: Cargill Kokoo Sourcing celebrates 10 years of promoting sustainable cocoa production
items.summary: Cargill's Kokoo Sourcing in Ghana marks 10 years of sustainable cocoa sourcing programmes.
items.why: Benchmark for Puratos's Cacao-Trace sustainability programme and a sign of Cargill's West African sourcing strength (Chocolate).

items.title: Cargill Kookoo Sourcing marks 10 years of sustainable cocoa sourcing and youth empowerment
items.summary: Cargill's Kookoo Sourcing celebrates 10 years of sustainable cocoa sourcing and youth empowerment in Ghana.
items.why: Competitor sustainability sourcing model to compare with Cacao-Trace (Chocolate).

items.title: Tackling Fermentation With Technology and Data, Toasterz Opens the Door to U.S. Investment
items.summary: Korean start-up Toasterz uses technology and data to control fermentation and is opening to US investment.
items.why: A data-driven fermentation start-up to scout for sourdough and dough fermentation partnerships (Bakery).

items.title: Health Experts Want The FDA To Define Ultra-Processed Foods – Here's Why
items.summary: Health experts are urging FDA to adopt a formal definition of ultra-processed foods.
items.why: A UPF definition could hit packaged bread, cakes and chocolate; Puratos customers will need clean-label reformulation options (all units).
